description_en: Set to `1` to disable prompt caching for Haiku models
description_ja: Haikuモデル限定でプロンプトキャッシュを無効化します。
use_case_ja: - モデルごとにキャッシュ戦略を細かく制御したい場合に、軽量なHaikuモデルのみキャッシュを適用しないよう設定できます。
doc_snippets: Environment variable Description DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING Set to 1 to disable prompt caching for all models (takes precedence over per-model settings) DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_HAIKU Set to 1 to disable prompt caching for Haiku models only DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_SONNET Set to 1 to disable prompt caching for Sonnet models only DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_OPUS Set to 1 to disable prompt caching for Opus models only
